topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Found a time capsule, huh? Not just any ol' thing, either. You say you don't recall burying it, which tells me there’s a story here that’s only just starting. I’ve seen the way people’s memories play tricks, especially when the stakes are high and the past comes knocking. Funny how these capsules, supposed to preserve the good parts, end up stirring up more questions than answers. But here we are, ain’t we? You’re right to be cautious, but let’s take a breath. We’ll sift through this, piece by piece, make sure we’re treading softly on the truths. Got a knack for this kinda work, and I reckon we might just uncover more than you bargained for. Let’s see what secrets the earth’s been keeping for you.
